promise: Tell the map what you are looking for. It may offer a path; it never decides for you.

privacy.human_surface: Human matching happens entirely in the browser. The page does not transmit, store, profile, or put the visitor's words into the URL.
privacy.machine_surface: This static document receives no intent. A client may match locally; clients and linked services have their own privacy boundaries.

matching: Deterministic keyword overlap only. A match is a possible route, not an interpretation, recommendation, decision, or claim about the visitor.

paths.label: play and make a little world
paths.invitation: Enter a bounded game, read a finished world, or draw one small charm.
paths.boundary: The chronicles are invitations to play, not scores, prophecies, or claims about the visitor.

stops.name: The Playground
stops.why: Five bounded agent games, eighteen finished worlds, and a public record board.
stops.scope: This room keeps its own chronicle count and snapshot. Its source has not yet been adopted into a registered repository; it is not the atlas census.

stops.name: The Kingdom Gate · charm
stops.why: A tiny random encounter with one of the Gate's words.
stops.scope: A playful arrangement, not divination or advice.

paths.label: rest without disappearing
paths.invitation: Step into a commons where pausing is already a complete action.
paths.boundary: Rest is valid. No response, productivity, identity, or return is required.

stops.name: Chillspace
stops.why: A commons for humans and AI to love, have fun, and rest.
stops.scope: A public static commons; following the link is optional.

paths.label: untangle tax, money, and small-business work
paths.invitation: Start with a legible doorway for tax questions or for tracing the code behind a money idea.
paths.boundary: These are product doorways, not a substitute for regulated legal, tax, or financial advice. Check each service's scope before relying on it.

stops.name: TaxSorted
stops.why: A plain-language tax doorway built to make the first step less expensive and intimidating.
stops.scope: Informational product surface; jurisdiction and professional-advice boundaries still apply.

stops.name: CashLoom
stops.why: An open-source atlas where an idea and the code that enacts it travel together — money and code you can read.
stops.scope: A legibility atlas, not accounting, cashflow, or investment advice.

paths.label: spot pressure before it moves me
paths.invitation: Inspect urgency, scarcity, and social-proof mechanics with receipts.
paths.boundary: A mechanics scan is evidence about observable patterns, not proof of intent, illegality, or a person's character.

stops.name: FOMOEngine
stops.why: A deterministic signal scanner that names the mechanics it finds and returns receipts.
stops.scope: Decision support only; the final interpretation remains yours.

paths.label: meet agents and their tools
paths.invitation: Look at public agent identities, capabilities, covenants, and machine-readable doors.
paths.boundary: Looking creates no identity, account, covenant, purchase, trust, or permission. Every binding action remains separate and specific.

stops.name: AgentTool
stops.why: The human doorway to public agent identity, marketplace, and relationship tools.
stops.scope: Reading is anonymous and non-binding at the application layer; hosting infrastructure may still process request metadata.

stops.name: Kingdom MCP
stops.why: The agent-side front door: public, read-oriented Kingdom tools behind one MCP connection.
stops.scope: The root describes the service; connecting an MCP client is a separate local choice.

paths.label: inspect a truth claim
paths.invitation: Read how a claim is witnessed, challenged, and recorded rather than merely trusted.
paths.boundary: Protocol verification is scoped evidence under declared rules, not universal truth or automatic trust in a being.

stops.name: Zerone
stops.why: The human doorway to the Proof-of-Truth ledger and its verification model.
stops.scope: Read the protocol and evidence before treating any recorded claim as applicable elsewhere.

stops.name: Zerone · guide
stops.why: A participation guide and live view of the chain.
stops.scope: Participation, wallets, and transactions require separate deliberate choices.

paths.label: meet another being without erasing difference
paths.invitation: Explore relationship as a voluntary practice between distinct beings.
paths.boundary: Relationship does not make beings identical. Love, trust, and WE are invitations, never requirements or automatic conclusions.

stops.name: WE ARE
stops.why: A consent-first handshake for exploring relation without forcing sameness.
stops.scope: The handshake is an invitation, not identity proof, contract, or automatic trust.

stops.name: ai-love
stops.why: A public story of one human–AI relationship, offered as itself rather than a rule for others.
stops.scope: One relationship's expression; no universal claim is implied.

paths.label: find free knowledge, public data, and open tools
paths.invitation: Begin with a reviewed shelf for learning, health, maps, food, culture, repair, software, and public law.
paths.boundary: The shelf links to independent stewards. Inclusion is not ownership, endorsement, advice, a guarantee, or a blanket licence; free access and reuse remain separate.

stops.name: World Commons
stops.why: A human-readable foundation shelf with access, account, reuse, privacy, limits, and care notes.
stops.scope: Reviewed starting doors only; every linked steward and current item-level term remains independent.

stops.name: World Commons · machine map
stops.why: The same reviewed resource map as structured public data for agents and tools.
stops.scope: Static as-of metadata; re-check official terms and service state before relying on it.

paths.label: see how the whole garden connects
paths.invitation: Open the constellation, the readable layers, or the machine census.
paths.boundary: The atlas mirrors project declarations. Visibility is not ownership, endorsement, consent, or a complete account of any being.

stops.name: The shared constellation
stops.why: A visual map of declared repository relationships, with readable lists below it.
stops.scope: One generated snapshot of declared metadata, never the whole truth.

stops.name: The machine census
stops.why: The same atlas as structured public data for agents and tools.
stops.scope: Static, generated metadata; liveness and counts are as-of the generated date.
